goals: Verify the Chrome extension correctly modifies HTTP headers and proxies requests when active.
Verify the Chrome extension's on/off toggle mechanism correctly enables and disables its header modification and request proxying functionalities.
activities: Set the Jest test timeout to 90 seconds.
Wait for the browser's service worker target to become available.
Extract the extension ID from the service worker target URL.
Wait for a specified duration for the extension to initialize.
Navigate the page to the header test URL.
Assert that the page content includes the 'X-Unblock-Youku-Test' header.
Navigate the page to 'http://example.com'.
Execute a script in the page context to create an XMLHttpRequest.
Open a GET request to the proxy test URL.
Send the XMLHttpRequest.
Assert that the XMLHttpRequest response contains 'true'.
Create a new browser page.
Navigate the new page to the extension's popup HTML page.
Wait for the 'off' button to appear on the popup page.
Click the 'off' button.
Wait for a specified duration for the extension to process the change.
Close the popup page.
Navigate the page to the header test URL.
Assert that the page content does NOT include the 'X-Unblock-Youku-Test' header.
Navigate the page to 'http://example.com'.
Execute a script in the page context to create an XMLHttpRequest.
Open a GET request to the proxy test URL.
Send the XMLHttpRequest.
Assert that the XMLHttpRequest response does NOT contain 'true'.
Create a new browser page.
Navigate the new page to the extension's popup HTML page.
Wait for the 'on' button to appear on the popup page.
Click the 'on' button.
Wait for a specified duration for the extension to process the change.
Close the popup page.
Navigate the page to the header test URL.
Assert that the page content includes the 'X-Unblock-Youku-Test' header.
Navigate the page to 'http://example.com'.
Execute a script in the page context to create an XMLHttpRequest.
Open a GET request to the proxy test URL.
Send the XMLHttpRequest.
Assert that the XMLHttpRequest response contains 'true'.
